observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black monocrystalline solar panel standing upright outdoors against a wall and fence.
Panel has a dark frame, full-black cells (no visible grid lines of silver busbars), consistent with a mono PERC or similar panel.
A watermark reading 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlays both images; this is the seller's branding/watermark, not a panel brand.
No visible rating label, junction box sticker, wattage marking, or model number on the front face in either photo.
Background shows other similar panels leaning nearby, suggesting a stock/yard of multiple units.
Ground is bare earth/concrete with some debris, consistent with an outdoor storage or display yard rather than a showroom.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium&Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: No test, certification, or rating label visible in photo 0 or photo 1; this is a general shop description, not a specific tested claim about the item shown.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating of the panel is unknown, which is the primary price driver for solar panels.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear junction-box sticker showing wattage, voltage, and model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest plausible wattage tier for a panel of this visible size

risks.risk: Panel may not actually produce rated output (cracked cells, delamination, or wiring faults not visible under glare).
risks.proof: A short video showing a multimeter or clamp meter reading voltage/current while the panel is in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: Panel could be used/refurbished rather than new, despite outdoor 'yard' look suggesting stock.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners/frame for scratches, dust patterns, or a manufacture date sticker.

risks.risk: Hidden micro-cracks in cells, which glare in both photos could be masking.
risks.proof: A glare-free, even-lit photo of the full panel face, or an EL (electroluminescence) test image if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible cell damage

risks.risk: Unclear if listing is for a single panel or a lot (multiple panels visible in background).
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of exact quantity included, with a photo showing all units together with a count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear label/sticker showing wattage, voltage (Vmp/Voc), and model number.
Video of the panel outputting voltage/current on a multimeter under sunlight.
Glare-free photo of the full panel surface to check for cracks or discoloration.
Confirmation of exact quantity being sold and whether price is per panel.
response.reason: The panel's wattage and model, which set its price, are not readable in either photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be assigned without that label or spec confirmation.
